visualReview.notes: Inspected all11 final portable/source-terrain views,including the1024×640 summary. Individual red-brick Saigon basilica:paired square towers with pale pointed metal spires,dormers and crosses;three-door front with large rose and clock beneath stepped gable;long red-tile nave/low aisles;rose-window transept;continuous choir ridge with polygonal apsidal fan and three lower rear chapel projections. Removed lower windows on tower faces buried by the nave/front and corrected a false valley at the nave/choir roof junction. Fine profiles and exact ground joins remain approximate.
